name: keyrotate-win32-x64
description: Windows x64 binary for keyrotate — the one-command API-key rotator that updates 1Password, GitHub, Supabase, Netlify, Fly.io, and .env files in a single command. This is a platform-specific binary package and should not be installed directly; install `keyrotate` instead and npm will select the correct binary for your OS.
author: BotFlow Lab
